messages:
elaine: Heads-up — customer feedback: SLO cards on tenant dashboard are noisy when multiple notify rules expand. Proposal: flatten to a single top-line 'Notify' summary with a hover/expand for details. Need to decide how this surfaces with routing, quotas, and telemetry before we can canary.

matt: Can you drop a screenshot? Also, are we talking purely UI flattening or changing the API that the console consumes? Concern about losing per-route escalation details.

elaine: Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/shot123 (mock). Idea: top-level 'Notify: Pager (1) · Email (2)' + a small gray "noise" badge when suppressions are active. Hover -> full list with routes, targets, last-fired timestamps. API keeps full notify_policy; UI reads a compact summary.

jia: Slightly worried about telemetry/alerts: product teams want to know which exact rule fired for regressions. If we hide it by default we'll lose quick triage signal. Maybe include a tiny 'last-fired' inline tag: e.g., "Pager · fired 12m ago (rule #c4f2)".

kevin: From platform side: we can emit two lightweight fields in /slo-status: `notify_summary` and `notify_telemetry`. `notify_summary` is what UI shows; `notify_telemetry` is a low-cardinality object we can hook into metrics. Minimal API change IMO.

opsbot: Note: canary window tomorrow 08:30 UTC for console. :bell:

matt: Also remember per-tenant quiet-windows / quota throttles. If a tenant is in quiet mode we should show "Suppressed" badge and link to quota burn page (otherwise CS pages will blow up).

ux-sara: From UX perspective: we like the compact line + hover. Hover should include: why suppressed (quiet-window or global-snooze), who owns escalation, and a link to rollout/actions. Keep primary card lines to max 2 rows. Use color/priority chip for urgency (red/orange/gray).

jia: Implementation detail: rule_id already appears in evaluation logs. To support telemetry we can emit a metric tag with `rule_hash` and `last_fired` timestamp. Concern: cardinality if teams create many one-off rules.

kevin: Cardinality mitigation: publish `rule_hash` truncated (4 chars) and server-side map for realtime lookups. Also sample verbose emissions for low-frequency rules. Proposed shape (pseudocode):

```
notify_summary: "Pager(1) · Email(2) · Suppressed(1)"
notify_telemetry: {
  last_fired: "2026-03-21T08:12:34Z",
  rule_key: "c4f2",
  suppression_score: "0.6"  // 0..1
}
```

kevin: We can keep the full policy in the API (`notify_policy`) untouched. The console will opt into `notify_summary`.

elaine: OK sounds reasonable. Can we gate behind two flags for the canary: `slo_notify_compact=true` (UI) and `notify_verbose=false` (telemetry default)? Then telemetry teams can opt-in per-tenant for verbose mapping.

matt: I'll draft the API contract PR with the new fields and add the feature flags. Also will wire the UI stub so we can flip on for the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: service=console version=2026.03.21-canary :rocket:

ux-sara: If canary hits odd behavior, we'll want quick rollback affordance in the card ("view raw notify policy") so SREs can still see full truth.

matt: Good call. I'll add a tiny "view raw" link in the hover.

jia: For telemetry owners: action item — decide sampling thresholds for verbose rule emissions. I can follow up with a short opt-in plan.

elaine: Action items summarized: matt -> PR for `notify_summary` + flags; kevin -> telemetry contract + cardinality plan; jia -> sampling thresholds; ux-sara -> hover design + raw-policy affordance. We'll flip canary for a small % of tenants first.

matt: I'll ping when PR is ready. Thanks all. :+1:

opsbot: Reminder: oncall rotation next week will get a heads-up about the canary.

kevin: Quick question — should we tag this change in release notes under "Console: SLO notify compacting (canary)"? Nice to have for CS.

elaine: Yes, add to release notes and include CS brief.

matt: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4128 (draft)

elaine: Nice. We'll review in async and sync up in the canary postmortem. :white_check_mark:
